about_the_game:
Run your own fantasy match-ups of chaotic marbles!

Enter your teams, pick your power-ups, and watch the laws of physics unravel in a marble-based simulation where no two matches ever play the same.

Play it idle, stream it live, record fantasy football match-ups or beat the keeper videos for your channel, or use it to settle life’s biggest decisions:

“What takeaway are we getting tonight?”

“What game shall I play next?”

“Who wins those 2 tickets to the Madonna 107th Birthday comeback tour!?”

Whether you’re here for the physics, the laughter, or the chaos, there’s one rule: Fate will decide the way.

Drop your marbles into 40+ arenas and watch as power-ups randomly trigger every 30 seconds:

  • Slasher Attack – A deadly marble spawns, taking out any marble it touches. Score penalties, chaos, and panic ensue.

  • Chicken Mania – Chickens invade the pitch, attempting to score, hiding secrets... Will they be clucking good… or clucking bad?

  • Multiball – Suddenly a team has six marbles on the pitch instead of one. Total mayhem guaranteed.

  • Keeper Pause – The defending keeper freezes, leaving your marbles to wreak havoc on the goal.

  • Double Goals / Minus Goal Goals – Each goal counts for more… or less. High stakes, unpredictable outcomes

  • Lucky Escape – Even the Slasher can misfire. Fate is fickle.

Marbles respawn after losses, sometimes shiny, giving huge scoring swings. Every match is a rollercoaster of unpredictability, power-ups, and emergent comedy.

Play idle, watch chaos unfold, or hunt for hidden secrets and Easter eggs. Stream it, share it, and let fate — and physics — decide everything.

Features

  • Endless chaos with 30-second power-ups – Slasher Attack, Multiball, Chicken Mania, Keeper Pause, Double Goals, Minus Goal Goals, and Lucky Escape

  • Chickens! – They can be harmless, they can be disastrous, they can be advantageous, some may hide rare marble unlocks...

  • Fate cards - Will those chickens harm of help your favorite team?

  • 150+ marble designs – Unlock through quests, cryptic challenges, and secret chicken hunts.

  • 60+ pitch designs

  • Idle or interactive – Sit back and let the simulation run, or jump in and hunt rare targets for hidden rewards.

  • 4-team mayhem – Full matches with 4 teams create insane unpredictability; 2-team matches are optional.

  • Perfect for streamers & content creators – Wild matches, absurd score swings, and unique moments every session.
